summary: Nested mapping updates must merge dictionaries instead of replacing them.

task.title: Deep-merge nested dictionaries
task.description: deep_merge(left, right) should return a new mapping. Nested dictionaries must be merged recursively. Non-dict values in right replace left. Do not mutate the input mappings.
constraints: Use only the Python standard library.

files.merge.py:
def deep_merge(left, right):
    merged = dict(left)
    merged.update(right)
    return merged
